# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v3 c4 P1](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher and student  <sub>[v1 c26 P8](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0008), [v1 c26 P12](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0012), [v3 c4 P1](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel Colby is a striking, dark-eyed young woman with a rose-red complexion. She is considered by some to be the beauty among the Second Year classes at Regent's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v1 c22 P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Mabel possesses a heart filled with yearning dreams and imaginations that rival Nell's. While she can be somewhat skeptical about marriage or high-minded expectations, she is a loyal, supportive friend who enjoys small-scale social activities and shared domestic life.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v3 c4 P1](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0001), [v3 c4 P15](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0015), [v3 c5 P4](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0004)_

## Goals

- Achieve higher education at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v1 c26 P8](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0008)</sub>
- Live in a shared home with friends while attending college  <sub>[v1 c26 P8](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0008)</sub>

## History

Mabel Colby attended Brierley school, where she befriended Nell Harcourt and offered to teach her a design for knit lace. She later attended Regent's Academy and pursued studies alongside Nell and Hugh Carrow, earning recognition as the beauty of the Second Year class. After completing studies at Regent's, she taught at an isolated rural school for several years, facing the typical trials of a country schoolteacher. Desiring to escape the monotony of country boarding and further her education, she applied to Wexcombe College for the Sophomore class. She proposed to Nell and Honora Hollis that they rent a house together in Portmaris to manage their own meals, bringing along her Aunt Euphemia as a housekeeper. The plan succeeded when they secured Tabby's Place, where Mabel took up residence alongside Nell, Honora, Cressida Lindsay, and Aunt Euphemia for their final years of university.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c26 P8](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0008), [v3 c4 P1](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0001), [v3 c4 P13](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0013), [v3 c5 P1](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0001)_
